raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Brings `.buildkite/test_areas/rust_frontend.yaml` up to date with what the Rust frontend passes today, using Python's own server-level tests. Every `-k` exclusion and commented-out command was re-run against the Rust frontend (and against Python for every failure): 10 stale exclusions are dropped, and the remaining ones now say why they exist. 11 commands from server-level test files that were not in the Rust CI yet are added, and three tests are modernized so they can run against the Rust frontend.

## Claims

- The Rust frontend CI steps run 10 previously excluded test selections and 11 more server-level test files, plus `test_completion.py` and the online custom logits-processor test on `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B`.
- Only `tests/` and `.buildkite/test_areas/rust_frontend.yaml` change, and no product code. A test is relaxed only where both behaviors are semantically acceptable (each relaxation also passes under the Python frontend); no assertion on the behavior under test is weakened.
- Two concurrent LoRA adapter tests in `test_lora_adapters.py` could never fail (their tasks were not awaited); they now can.

## Validation

Local, GB200, `VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1`, `vllm-rs` built from this base with `VLLM_RS_BUILD_VERSION` set to the vLLM version; `--gpu-memory-utilization` capped through a pytest plugin (another job shares the GPUs), no test-file change. Each changed command, exactly as in the YAML:

```
benchmarks/test_serve_cli.py                      # gated model; substitute run: 3 passed (Rust and Python)
test_chat_completion.py -k "not test_kv_transfer_prompt_token_ids_round_trip and not ..._streaming"   # 6 passed, 2 deselected
launchers/test_shutdown.py -k "not engine_failure"                                                    # 7 passed, 1 deselected
test_return_token_ids.py                                                                              # 6 passed
instrumentator/test_basic.py                                                                          # 6 passed
token_in_token_out/test_serving_tokens.py -k "not lora"                                               # 10 passed, 16 skipped, 1 deselected
instrumentator/test_metrics.py -k "not run_batch and not test_metrics_exist"                          # 9 passed, 3 skipped, 7 deselected
tool_use --ignore=tool_use/mistral --models llama3.2                                                  # gated model; mirror run: 365 passed, 84 skipped
```

Step 2, under Rust, with memory capped to an 18 GB slice (35 GB for Tool Use):

```
chat_completion/test_chat_echo.py                                                     # 4 passed
chat_completion/test_logprob_token_ids.py                                             # 9 passed
chat_completion/test_thinking_token_budget.py -k "not qwen35"                         # 6 passed, 1 deselected
completion/test_tensorizer_entrypoint.py --timeout=900 --timeout-method=thread        # 1 passed
test_chunked_prompt.py                                                                # 2 passed
serve/middleware/test_optional_middleware.py -k "not test_v2_..."                     # 8 passed, 1 deselected
launchers/api_server/test_multi_api_servers.py                                        # 2 passed
rl/return_routed_experts/test_scale_out_api.py                                        # 1 passed
chat_completion/test_completion_with_function_calling.py -k "not test_no_args_tool_call"  # 28 passed, 2 deselected
tool_parsers/test_granite4_tool_parser.py                                             # 1 passed
tool_parsers/test_hermes_tool_parser.py -k granite4                                   # 4 passed, 4 deselected
```

Every relaxed test also passes under the Python frontend.

Distributed step, on a separate clean 4-GPU node, the previously excluded cases only (`-k "4 or server_info"`):

```
TP_SIZE=1 DP_SIZE=4 v1/distributed/test_internal_lb_dp.py   # Rust: 4 passed, 2 failed (server_info); Python: 6 passed
TP_SIZE=1 DP_SIZE=2 v1/distributed/test_external_lb_dp.py   # Rust: 2 passed, 3 failed (server_info); Python: 5 passed
TP_SIZE=1 DP_SIZE=4 v1/distributed/test_hybrid_lb_dp.py     # Rust: 2 passed, 2 failed (server_info); Python: 4 passed
```

`ruff check`/`ruff format --check` (0.14.0), `check_buildkite_step_keys.py` and `check_test_tethering.py` pass.

## Details

| Item | CI step | Python test | Finding | Action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| invalid structured-output inputs | OpenAI Coverage | `test_chat_completion.py::test_invalid_json_schema`, `::test_invalid_regex` | pass: Rust returns the 400 | drop exclusion |
| streamed logprobs comparison | OpenAI Coverage | `test_return_token_ids.py::test_comparison_with_prompt_logprobs_and_logprobs` | Rust streams a leading `prompt_token_ids` chunk and a trailing `finish_reason` chunk with `logprobs: null` (nullable in the OpenAI schema); the test dereferenced `logprobs.tokens` on every chunk | enable; the loop skips null logprobs, the token-id equality assertion is unchanged |
| stale shutdown clause | OpenAI Coverage | `test_shutdown.py` | `test_abort_timeout_exits_quickly` was renamed (`test_abort_timeout_exits_within_cleanup_grace`), so the clause matched nothing | drop the clause |
| benchmark CLI | OpenAI Coverage | `benchmarks/test_serve_cli.py` insecure, `test_bench_serve` | gated Llama 3.2 1B cannot be downloaded locally; with Qwen2.5-1.5B swapped in, all pass under Rust and Python | drop exclusion; CI is the final check |
| server load | Serve/Admin | `test_basic.py` `server_load` | 15/15 across three fresh servers; not flaky | drop exclusion |
| generate endpoint | Serve/Admin | `test_serving_tokens.py` `stream`, `test_generate_logprobs`, `stop_string_workflow` | pass; the `top_logprobs` truncation comment was stale. Four `stream` cases self-skip under Rust | keep only `-k "not lora"` |
| metrics | Serve/Admin | `test_metrics.py` `show`, `test_metrics_counts`, multimodal variants | pass (multimodal `test_metrics_counts` self-skips) | `-k "not run_batch and not test_metrics_exist"` |
| in-process selection | OpenAI Coverage | `test_serving_chat.py` three `-k`-selected tests | they run over a `MockEngine` in-process and never reach Rust | drop the line |
| DP load balancing | Distributed | `v1/distributed/test_{internal,external,hybrid}_lb_dp.py` `4` cases (`--api-server-count 4`) | pass: the Rust frontend ignores the count and serves them from one multithreaded process | `-k "not server_info"` |
| tool use | Tool Use | `test_response_format_with_tool_choice_required`, `test_parallel_tool_calls_false`, `test_tool_call_and_choice` | gated Llama 3.2 3B; the ungated mirror `unsloth/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct` with the same config passes 5/5 each | drop exclusions; CI is the final check |

Step 2, new commands (each passes locally under Rust with `--gpu-memory-utilization` capped to the CI slice size):

| CI step | Command | Note |
|---|---|---|
| OpenAI Coverage | `chat_completion/test_chat_echo.py` | relaxed: the test sent `"logprobs": "true"` (a string); the OpenAI schema says boolean, and Rust only accepts a boolean, so it sends `True` |
| OpenAI Coverage | `chat_completion/test_logprob_token_ids.py` | |
| OpenAI Coverage | `chat_completion/test_thinking_token_budget.py -k "not qwen35"` | the Qwen3.5-35B FP8 MTP case needs two GPUs |
| OpenAI Coverage | `completion/test_tensorizer_entrypoint.py` | relaxed: Rust also sends `completion_tokens_details`, so the usage check compares the three counts instead of the whole object |
| OpenAI Coverage | `test_chunked_prompt.py` | relaxed: Rust ends the stream with a finish-only chunk and sends the role chunk without `content`; every chunk that carries tokens is still checked |
| Serve/Admin | `serve/middleware/test_optional_middleware.py -k "not test_v2_endpoint_accepts_valid_api_token"` | the excluded test calls `/v2/embed` (pooling) |
| Serve/Admin | `launchers/api_server/test_multi_api_servers.py` | Rust ignores `--api-server-count` and runs one server, so this only checks the flag is accepted |
| Serve/Admin | `rl/return_routed_experts/test_scale_out_api.py` | |
| Tool Use | `chat_completion/test_completion_with_function_calling.py -k "not test_no_args_tool_call"` | relaxed: a tool-call-only message has `content: null` in Rust and `""` in Python. The empty-`arguments` history case is a Rust bug (500, fixed by vllm-project/vllm#63314); the `{}` case passes but shares the name |
| Tool Use | `tool_parsers/test_granite4_tool_parser.py` | |
| Tool Use | `tool_parsers/test_hermes_tool_parser.py -k granite4` | the llama cases use `--lora-modules` |

Tests that need a pending Rust fix (the LoRA request field, the gpt-oss parser selection, a single structured-outputs backend, ORCA headers, and others) are left for follow-up PRs.

Still excluded, each with a comment (Rust fixes tracked separately):

- `test_kv_transfer_prompt_token_ids_*`: Rust re-renders `messages` instead of reusing `kv_transfer_params["prompt_token_ids"]`.
- `completion/test_prompt_validation.py` (stays commented out): `test_empty_prompt` gets a body-deserialization 400 for `prompt: null` instead of Python's "Either prompt or prompt_embeds must be provided and non-empty." The Rust fix comes first; the test then runs unrelaxed.
- `test_chat_logit_bias_multiple_non_integer_keys`: enabled together with its fix in vllm-project/vllm#63313, and this PR leaves that line alone.
- `test_serving_tokens.py` `lora`: the Rust `LoraRequest` still encodes `tensorizer_config_dict`, removed by vllm-project/vllm#60024, so `--lora-modules` fails at startup; the fix is vllm-project/vllm#63295.
- `test_metrics.py` `test_metrics_exist`: `vllm:admission_rejections` (open vllm-project/vllm#61296) and image inputs.
- `test_tokenization.py` `tokenizer_info`: Rust returns 501 (the old comment said no-op).
- `tool_use/mistral`: no `mistral` tokenizer mode or renderer in Rust.
- `test_shutdown_on_engine_failure`: launches the Python API server entry directly.
- `test_*_lb_dp.py` `server_info`: `/server_info` reports the Rust frontend's own config, which has no `parallel_config`; the `api-server-count=4` variants also expect four API processes.

Step timeouts, NVIDIA (AMD): OpenAI Coverage 30→50 (35→55), Serve/Admin 25→45 (30→50), Tool Use 25→35 (30→40). Locally, step 1 added about 10 minutes each to OpenAI Coverage and Serve/Admin (`test_metrics.py` alone took 6 and `test_basic.py` with `server_load` 4), and step 2 adds about 10, 7 and 9 minutes to the three steps.


### Test modernization

All runs on a GB200 node through Slurm (`--exclusive`), from `tests/`, `VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn`, Rust runs with `VLLM_USE_RUST_FRONTEND=1` and a `vllm-rs` built from this branch.

| Commit | Change | Rust | Python |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15926920cd | `test_completion.py`: `facebook/opt-125m` → `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` (prompt token counts 6/11 → 5/10); two relaxations; added to OpenAI Coverage with `-k "not test_single_completion and not test_prompt_logprobs_completion and not test_parallel and not test_batch_completions"` | CI selection 17 passed, 8 deselected; full file 18 passed, 7 failed (the excluded ones) | full file 25 passed |
| e4d485677e | `test_lora_adapters.py`: `test_multiple_lora_adapters` and `test_beam_search_with_lora_adapters` await their tasks with `asyncio.gather` (they could not fail); the beam test gets its own adapter names, since it collided with the first test's adapters on the shared server once it could fail. Not added to Rust CI (needs the `LoraRequest` fix, vllm-project/vllm#63295) | red-green with a `vllm-rs` that has the `LoraRequest` fix: old file 2 passed, new file 2 failed (batched prompts, a known gap) | full file 13 passed |
| 9659e0be68 | `test_custom_online.py` serves `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` (as `test_completion.py`); added to OpenAI Coverage with `-k "not test_invalid_custom_logitsproc_arg"`. The offline tests keep opt-125m | CI selection 2 passed; `test_invalid_custom_logitsproc_arg` fails (the Rust frontend cannot run the processor's `validate_params`, so the invalid argument reaches the engine instead of returning 400) | file 4 passed |

Relaxations in `test_completion.py` (both behaviors acceptable):

- `test_completion_streaming`: the last chunk may carry only the `finish_reason`; the joined streamed text is still compared with the non-streaming output (same relaxation as `test_chunked_prompt.py`).
- `test_completion_stream_options`: with `stream=false`, `{"include_usage": null}` and `{"continuous_usage_stats": null}` may be accepted as unset (Rust) or rejected (Python); the non-null cases still require a 400.

Why the offline logits-processor tests keep opt-125m: with SmolLM2-135M (bf16; Instruct and base), `test_custom_logitsprocs` failed in 2 of 3 runs of the file because a request that does not use the processor flipped a near-tied greedy token between the two `LLM` instances. Only the online test reaches the Rust frontend.

Not a duplicate: no open PR changes the Rust frontend test selection.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to prepare this change; the human submitter reviewed every changed line.

- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.

</details>

- `test_completion_streaming`: the last chunk may carry only the `finish_reason`; the joined streamed text is still compared with the non-streaming output (same relaxation as `test_chunked_prompt.py`).
- `test_completion_stream_options`: with `stream=false`, `{"include_usage": null}` and `{"continuous_usage_stats": null}` may be accepted as unset (Rust) or rejected (Python); the non-null cases still require a 400.

Why the offline logits-processor tests keep opt-125m: with SmolLM2-135M (bf16; Instruct and base), `test_custom_logitsprocs` failed in 2 of 3 runs of the file because a request that does not use the processor flipped a near-tied greedy token between the two `LLM` instances. Only the online test reaches the Rust frontend.

Not a duplicate: no open PR changes the Rust frontend test selection.

AI assistance (Claude Code) was used to prepare this change; the human submitter reviewed every changed line.
